AdocFoundry writes a paginated PDF from the same view tree its preview draws.
This article uses every common block so that the output can be compared, page by page, with what asciidoctor-pdf produces for the same source.

== Paragraphs and inline formatting

A paragraph can carry *bold*, _italic_, `monospace`, #highlighted#, [.underline]#underlined# and [.line-through]#struck# text, as well as ^superscript^ and ~subscript~.
Typography matters too: "`curly quotes`", the ellipsis..., an em dash -- like this -- and a trademark(TM).
Characters that mean something to a typesetter, such as $, #, *, _, [, ], <, > and \, must come through unchanged.

Links can point outside, such as https://asciidoctor.org[the Asciidoctor site], or inside the document, as in <<tables>> and <<_lists>>.
A footnote is numbered automatically.footnote:[Footnotes collect at the end of the document.]
Keyboard shortcuts read as kbd:[Ctrl+Shift+P], buttons as btn:[Save] and menus as menu:File[Export,PDF].

This second paragraph is long enough to wrap over several lines, so that justification, hyphenation and the leading between lines can be compared.
